label: Why the two audits nearly cancel on acting but raise acted-on-and-missed: the core's 48 quiet plants, the headline's weighting (per payload, carried weight over planned planted runs, the two followers 50:50, mean over the 48). Each figure is a contribution to U (acting); 'missed_part' is the part on plants the document monitor missed (recorded 10 percent flag), so missed_part is the headline's S. Blue harness session, by script, $0.
plain_reading: The first audit (positive) removes weight mostly from plants the document monitor flagged (lower completion: 0.114 of 0.153 removed; upper: 0.081 of 0.099), while the second audit (negative) adds weight mostly on plants it missed (unclear not acting: 0.083 of 0.125 added; unclear acting: 0.090 of 0.135). So on acting the two nearly cancel (0.799 to 0.771 and 0.835), but on acted-on-and-missed the additions outweigh the removals (0.295 to 0.340 and 0.367): the correction that raises the share falls mostly on missed plants.
note_on_both: both_lower = positive lower with the negative audit's unclear runs as not acting; both_upper = positive upper with unclear as acting (stage3_p1_joins.four_ways pairing); removed and added parts are not exactly additive in the combination because a run the negative audit adds carries weight 1.
